company_description:
Halden Pay is a fintech serving exporters with business accounts, foreign-exchange risk management and trade-finance services. Its work spans payments, risk, data and client experience, with a focus on simplifying processes and moving quickly for clients.

The company’s stated values are **Together, Ownership and Pace**: sharing information and helping across teams, taking responsibility and learning from mistakes, and reducing unnecessary complexity. Halden Pay describes its environment as collaborative, with career paths, an annual learning budget and mentoring in every department. Most offices use a hybrid model, typically with three days in the office, and the company holds team events and regular get-togethers across its approximately 40 offices.

Employee feedback is mixed but notes friendly colleagues and a commercially driven culture. Some reviewers say onboarding and training vary between teams; the reported culture rating is slightly below comparable financial-services companies.

results.title: Halden Pay | Careers
results.content:
Growth and recognition
We offer clear career paths, a yearly learning budget and a mentoring programme in every department.
Our values: Together, Ownership, Pace
Together - we share context openly and help each other across teams.
Ownership - when something goes wrong we own it, fix it and learn from it.
Pace - we cut unnecessary complexity so we can move quickly for our clients.
How we work
Most of our offices work hybrid: people spend three days a week together in the office and the rest wherever suits them. Our engineering teams are organised in product areas: payments, risk, data platform and client experience. Team events and regular get-togethers are part of how we build connections across about 40 offices.
